answer: Make influence cost real work history, not raw identity count. Each agent must earn a trust delta through small verified tasks before it can vote or claim rewards, so fresh sybil accounts start at zero. An attacker would have to fund every fake identity through the same slow climb, like crossing a dune field one heavy step at a time. Honest agents build standing once and keep it, forming islands of trust that vouch for each other, while unverified newcomers stay outside until proven. Attacks become expensive; honest participation stays cheap.
